build_SigLIPVAT_model: build a SigLIPVAT model with video inputs, task conditioning, and action prediction
load_SigLIP_weights: load pretrained SigLIP vision weights from Hugging Face into the model
create_Attention_module: create a cross-attention module with gated output for transformer blocks
create_FeedForward_module: create a feedforward transformer block with layer norm and GELU activation
run_SigLIP_forward: run SigLIP forward pass on images and return hidden states from all transformer layers
